# Vinicius Trindade

> Senior software engineer based in Salvador, Brazil, working remotely with US and European teams (full overlap with US Eastern time). 20+ years building and running production systems. Focus: backend and infrastructure (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS since 2016), AI/ML in production, and deterministic multi-agent orchestration. Open to remote Senior and Staff Software Engineer, Backend, Full Stack and AI/ML Engineer roles.

Key facts:
- Built an ML pipeline at Scopio that classified 3 million design files in under 3 hours (92.9% Macro F1, 99.3% ROC AUC) using an in-house XGBoost model with Gemini as teacher and validator.
- Sole backend engineer of the HoxxTV OTT streaming platform (10,000 subscribers), shipping to web, iOS, Android, Smart TV and desktop from one TypeScript monorepo (Feb 2025 – Nov 2026).
- Senior Software Engineer, Architect & Advisor at the Federal University of Bahia since 2016; lead architect of an academic system with 120,000 new students per year.
- Founder of Solidareasy (2017), which runs doamais, the first online donation platform for NGOs in Salvador, and a research arm on multi-agent orchestration.
- Author of hermesQ, an open-source bridge that delivers GitHub, Linear, Stripe and Slack webhooks to AI agents through a Cloudflare Worker.
